value.rationale: Two quantitatively different casting-voter thresholds distinguish a natural participation target (fraction of votes successfully represented) from the stringent fairness target of no lost ballots. The critical Gaussian profile, finite-N exact probabilities and Poisson-cycle limit give actionable, precisely scoped mathematical benchmarks rather than a mere renamed enumeration.
